title: TangramPuzzle: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models with Compositional Spatial Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2601.16520v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual recognition and semantic understanding, yet precise compositional spatial reasoning under geometric constraints remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks mainly assess coarse spatial relations and rarely support rigorous geometric verification or multiple valid solutions in constructive tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce TangramPuzzle, a benchmark comprising 668 validated configurations and 1,336 instances for evaluating compositional spatial reasoning under geometric constraints. We formulate the Tangram Construction Expression (TCE) to encode tangram configurations with machine-verifiable geometric specifications, together with a multi-solution-aware verifier that separately evaluates geometric validity and silhouette fidelity. translated_title: 七巧板拼图：用组合空间推理评估多模态大语言模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.16520v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉识别和语义理解方面取得了显著进展，但在几何约束下的精确组合空间推理仍未得到充分探索。现有基准主要评估粗略的空间关系，很少支持严格的几何验证或构造性任务中的多种有效解决方案。为解决这些局限性，我们引入了TangramPuzzle，一个包含668个验证配置和1,336个实例的基准，用于评估几何约束下的组合空间推理。我们提出了七巧板构造表达式（TCE），用机器可验证的几何规范编码七巧板配置，并配备了一个支持多解感知的验证器，分别评估几何有效性和轮廓保真度。TangramPuzzle涵盖两个互补的评估任务：部分到整体的轮廓预测和整体到部分的……（摘要不完整，但已翻译主要部分）
tldr: 本文提出了TangramPuzzle基准，通过七巧板构造表达式和双维度验证器，首次实现了对多模态大语言模型在几何约束下组合空间推理的严格机器可验证评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TangramPuzzle, a benchmark with TCE encoding and a dual-aspect verifier, enabling rigorous machine-verifiable evaluation of MLLMs' compositional spatial reasoning under geometric constraints.
